about: Decision table shared by issuer-server/lib-owner-proof.js and issuer-php/lib/owner-proof.php. Each case is a request body, the context the issuer supplies, and the exact verdict both must return. Signatures are raw P-256 over the canonical payload, made with throw-away test keys.

cases.name: off: an unsigned request is not this check's business
off: even a bad intent is ignored
accept: an unsigned request passes as an unsigned issuance
accept: an intent of null counts as none
require: an unsigned request is refused
require: an intent of null is refused
a class outside the three is never gated (require)
